---
toc: false
sidebar: false
format:
  html:
    css: styles.css
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          /* ===== Minimal, tight layout ===== */
          .sec {
            font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #333;
            margin: 1rem 0 0.35rem; padding-top: 0.6rem;
            border-top: 1px solid #e6e6e6;
          }

          .pubs { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 1rem 0rem 0rem 2rem; }
          .paper  { margin: 0 0 0.8rem 0;
          line-height: 1.45;  
                }

          /* Title line: bold-ish blue title + authors inline */
          .title { margin: 0; line-height: 1.3; }
          .title a { color: #0b4bb3; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; }
          .title a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
          .authors-after { color: #333; font-weight: 400; margin-left: 6px; }

          /* Status: free-form (multi-line), own line */
          .status-line { color: #555; margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 0.92em; white-space: pre-wrap; }

          /* Awards — two types: award vs other */
          .awards-wrap { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 0.92em; }
          .awards-list { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.1rem; font-size: 0.92rem; }
          .awards-list li { margin: 0; }
          .award-item.award { color: rgb(164,143,86); font-weight: 500; }
          .award-item.other { color: #444; }
          .awards-list a { color:#0b4bb3; text-decoration:none; }
          .awards-list a:hover { text-decoration:none; }

          /* Teaser + [more]/[less] inline */
          .teaser { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #6f6f6f; font-size: .92rem; }
          .teaser-text { display: inline; }
          .more-btn, .less-btn { display:inline; margin-left:6px; border:0; background:none; color:#0b4bb3; cursor:pointer; padding:0; font-size:.92rem; }
          .more-btn:hover, .less-btn:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
          .abstract { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #333; }
          .hidden { display: none; }

          /* Indent sub-lines under the title */
          .paper > .status-line, .paper > .awards-wrap, .paper > .teaser, .paper > .abstract { margin-left: 1.2em; }

          /* ===== Switcher UI ===== */
          .switcher { display:flex; gap:.5rem; align-items:center; margin:.6rem 0 .2rem 0; }
          .switch-btn {
            padding: .35rem .6rem; border: 1px solid #e1e1e1; background:#fafafa; cursor:pointer; border-radius: 8px; font-size:.92rem;
          }
          .switch-btn.active { background:#eff5ff; border-color:#cbdcf8; color:#174ea6; }

          /* Topic block heading matches your small section-title look */
          .topic-title {   font-family: "Montserrat", sans-serif; 
          font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; color: #333; 
          margin: 1rem 0 0.35rem; padding-top: 0.6rem; border-top: 1px solid #e6e6e6; }
        </style>
---

<!-- Switcher -->
<div class="switcher" role="tablist" aria-label="Publications view">
  <button id="btn-date"  class="switch-btn active" role="tab" aria-selected="true">By Date</button>
  <button id="btn-topic" class="switch-btn" role="tab" aria-selected="false">By Topic</button>
</div>

<!-- By Date view (your current layout) -->
<div id="view-by-date">
  <div class="section-title">Preprints/Working Papers</div>
  <ul id="pub-preprint" class="pubs"></ul>

  <div class="section-title">Published/Accepted Papers</div>
  <ul id="pub-published" class="pubs"></ul>
</div>

<!-- By Topic view (generated; same per-paper format) -->
<div id="view-by-topic" class="hidden"></div>

<!-- ========= RENDER SCRIPT: By Date + By Topic (same card format) ========= -->
<script>
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const THEMES = [{
    id: "sequential decisions",
    label: "Efficient Algorithms for Sequential Decision-Making",
    desc: "..."
  },
  {
    id: "platform",
    label: "Algorithm and Mechanism Design for Platforms",
    desc: "..."
  } ]; // ← edit to 2–3 blocks you want
  const OTHER_LABEL = "Other";

  const dataEl = document.getElementById('papers-data');
  const PAPERS = JSON.parse((dataEl?.textContent || '[]').trim());

  // Switcher elements
  const byDateWrap  = document.getElementById('view-by-date');
  const byTopicWrap = document.getElementById('view-by-topic');
  const btnDate  = document.getElementById('btn-date');
  const btnTopic = document.getElementById('btn-topic');

  // Helpers
  function inferBucket(status) {
    const s = (status || '').toLowerCase();
    return (s.includes('published') || s.startsWith('forthcoming') || s.startsWith('accepted') || s.includes('conditionally accepted'))
      ? 'Published' : 'Preprint';
  }

  // Sort by year (desc), then rank (asc if provided), then title
  const byYear = (a, b) => {
    if (b.year !== a.year) return b.year - a.year;
    if (a.rank !== undefined && b.rank !== undefined) return a.rank - b.rank;
    if (a.rank !== undefined) return -1;
    if (b.rank !== undefined) return 1;
    return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  };

  // One paper entry (your existing compact format)
  function liFor(p){
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = 'paper';

    const titleP = document.createElement('p');
    titleP.className = 'title';
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = p.url || '#';
    a.target = '_blank';
    a.textContent = p.title;
    titleP.appendChild(a);
    if (p.authors && p.authors.trim()) {
      const spanAuth = document.createElement('span');
      spanAuth.className = 'authors-after';
      spanAuth.textContent = ` (with ${p.authors})`;
      titleP.appendChild(spanAuth);
    }
    li.appendChild(titleP);

    if (p.status && p.status.trim()) {
      const st = document.createElement('div');
      st.className = 'status-line';
      st.innerHTML = (p.status || '').replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
      li.appendChild(st);
    }

    // Awards (two types, support object/strings; allow HTML links)
    if (p.awards && p.awards.length) {
      const wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'awards-wrap';
      const ul = document.createElement('ul');
      ul.className = 'awards-list';

      const norm = (item) => {
        if (typeof item === 'string') {
          const s = item.trim();
          if (s.toLowerCase().startsWith('award:')) return { type:'award', text:s.slice(6).trim() };
          if (s.toLowerCase().startsWith('other:')) return { type:'other', text:s.slice(6).trim() };
          return { type:'award', text:s };
        }
        return { type: (item.type||'award').toLowerCase(), text: item.text || '' };
      };

      (p.awards || []).map(norm).forEach(({type, text})=>{
        if (!text) return;
        const liw = document.createElement('li');
        liw.className = 'award-item ' + (type === 'other' ? 'other' : 'award');
        liw.innerHTML = text;
        ul.appendChild(liw);
      });

      wrap.appendChild(ul);
      li.appendChild(wrap);
    }

    const teaserP = document.createElement('p');
    teaserP.className = 'teaser';
    const spanTeaser = document.createElement('span');
    spanTeaser.className = 'teaser-text';
    spanTeaser.textContent = p.teaser || '';
    teaserP.appendChild(spanTeaser);

    if (p.abstract && p.abstract.trim()) {
      const more = document.createElement('button');
      more.className = 'more-btn';
      more.type = 'button';
      more.textContent = '[more]';
      teaserP.appendChild(more);

      const absP = document.createElement('p');
      absP.className = 'abstract hidden';
      absP.textContent = (p.abstract || '') + ' ';
      const lessBtn = document.createElement('button');
      lessBtn.className = 'less-btn';
      lessBtn.type = 'button';
      lessBtn.textContent = '[less]';
      absP.appendChild(lessBtn);

      more.addEventListener('click', () => {
        spanTeaser.classList.add('hidden');
        more.classList.add('hidden');
        absP.classList.remove('hidden');
      });
      lessBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        absP.classList.add('hidden');
        spanTeaser.classList.remove('hidden');
        more.classList.remove('hidden');
      });

      li.appendChild(teaserP);
      li.appendChild(absP);
    } else {
      li.appendChild(teaserP);
    }

    return li;
  }

  // ===== Render: BY DATE =====
  (function renderByDate(){
    const ulPre = document.getElementById('pub-preprint');
    const ulPub = document.getElementById('pub-published');
    ulPre.innerHTML = ''; ulPub.innerHTML = '';

    const preprint = [], published = [];
    PAPERS.forEach(p => {
      const b = (p.bucket || '').trim();
      const bucket = (b ? b : inferBucket(p.status));
      (bucket.toLowerCase().startsWith('pub') || bucket.toLowerCase().startsWith('acc') ? published : preprint).push(p);
    });

    preprint.sort(byYear);
    published.sort(byYear);

    preprint.forEach(p => ulPre.appendChild(liFor(p)));
    published.forEach(p => ulPub.appendChild(liFor(p)));
  })();

  // ===== Render: BY TOPIC =====
  // ------- Theme matching helpers (case-insensitive) -------
const NORM = s => (s || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const THEME_IDS      = THEMES.map(t => t.id);
const THEME_IDS_LOWER= THEMES.map(t => NORM(t.id));
const THEME_META     = Object.fromEntries(THEMES.map(t => [t.id, t]));

function canonicalThemeId(s) {
  const idx = THEME_IDS_LOWER.indexOf(NORM(s));
  return idx >= 0 ? THEME_IDS[idx] : null; // return canonical cased id
}

function themeOf(p) {
  // Prefer explicit "theme"
  if (p.theme) {
    const canon = canonicalThemeId(p.theme);
    if (canon) return canon;
  }
  // Then scan "topics" array
  const topics = Array.isArray(p.topics) ? p.topics : [];
  for (const t of topics) {
    const canon = canonicalThemeId(t);
    if (canon) return canon;
  }
  return OTHER_LABEL;
}

// ------- Render: BY TOPIC -------
(function renderByTopic(){
  const wrap = byTopicWrap;
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  const buckets = {};

  PAPERS.forEach(p => {
    const k = themeOf(p);
    (buckets[k] ||= []).push(p);
  });

  // Order: all defined THEMES (by id), then "Other" if present
  const order = THEME_IDS.slice();
  if (buckets[OTHER_LABEL]?.length) order.push(OTHER_LABEL);

  order.forEach(id => {
    const arr = (buckets[id] || []).slice().sort(byYear);
    if (!arr.length) return;

    const meta = THEME_META[id];

    // Header
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'topic-title';
    h.dataset.topic = id;                // allows per-topic CSS, if desired
    h.textContent = meta ? meta.label : id;
    wrap.appendChild(h);

    // Optional description
    if (meta?.desc) {
      const desc = document.createElement('div');
      desc.className = 'topic-desc';
      desc.textContent = meta.desc;
      wrap.appendChild(desc);
    }

    // List
    const ul = document.createElement('ul');
    ul.className = 'pubs';
    arr.forEach(p => ul.appendChild(liFor(p)));
    wrap.appendChild(ul);
  });
})();

  

  // ===== Switch behavior =====
  function activate(which){
    const isDate = (which === 'date');
    byDateWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDate);
    byTopicWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', isDate);
    btnDate.classList.toggle('active', isDate);
    btnTopic.classList.toggle('active', !isDate);
    btnDate.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(isDate));
    btnTopic.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(!isDate));
  }
  btnDate.addEventListener('click', ()=>activate('date'));
  btnTopic.addEventListener('click',()=>activate('topic'));
});
</script>
